items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I talked to Buddy Tate, Quinclette and Milt Hinton and Jack Williams, and they understood.

ctx.x: Well, you know, I got him to come into that. I told George Wein to bring him into that, Newport Festival. And, you know, they just buried him. I mean, he hardly was heard.

Then another time when he came in here with Claude Williams, Claude Williams buried him, and that was his own fault. But this time, playing in Michael's Pub, the (unintelligible) said, would I talk to the guys, because he wanted to hear McShann's piano and McShann's singing. So, you know. I talked to Buddy Tate, Quinclette and Milt Hinton and Jack
Williams, and they understood. But it was really very good. I mean, I'm not taking any credit for it, but Jay himself wouldn't have said anything.
